checks.detail: coverage.validation.runtime.8581df546013=insufficient_evidence; coverage.validation.visual.fb0eb54ed527=insufficient_evidence; coverage.task.done_when.3cdb381d6699=insufficient_evidence; Independent observations support source-derived enemy binding, progressing clips, contact/damage, hurt/death, target loss/return, pause/load interruption, recovery and singular rewards. NPC demonstrations, H rejection and safe broad telemetry were observed. Correction completes restoration-notice coverage at both resolutions/all three scales, but first-teaching/first-reward variants and deliberate obstacle negotiation remain unverified. Existing collected histories and no-reward replay cannot substitute for those notice states. Broader prior HUD histories/fault debt remains unresolved without expanding this frozen criterion. Developer risk handoff remains not_validated; implementation claims do not replace acceptance.

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

developer_outcome.summary: Implementation and fresh runnable handoff are delivered. Independent foundation acceptance, complete ordinary HUD/title histories, Host fault/life fixtures and combat-audio causality remain unverified. Existing map/player UV findings remain outside this correction.

risk_note.summary: Conversion, rig/contact adaptation and navigation can appear correct in source while failing visibly; Host fixtures remain unavailable for parts of HUD closeout.
risk_note.validation: Use an early import/contact prototype, then independent ordinary-input enemy and NPC sequences with paired frames, state and audio. Request the exact Host life-history/fault fixtures and retain every missing matrix cell as insufficient evidence.
risk_note.why_now: The active gate requires the complete actor unit, the pinned input conflict affects its usable controls, and unsafe shared telemetry can interrupt the independent observations needed to assess it.

task_requirements.requirement: A live reusable Snaiel-derived enemy on the existing Forest route visibly progresses through idle, patrol, pursuit, anticipation, attack, recovery, hurt and death; bone-bound contact, obstacle handling, sword/arrow damage, pause/load interruption, death recovery and one-time reward settlement work through the retained product authorities.

Ronen and Hers have distinct complete presentation actors with working demonstrations and no player-control ownership; the original H-rebind scenario has readable rejection or exclusive working action dispatch, reward/teaching/restoration notices expose no quest codes and leave ammunition readable at both required resolutions and all three text scales, and broad actor observation completes safely.
